correctness.rationale: The all-index proof establishes gcd and recurrence identities, excludes all generator redundancies beyond n=3,4,5, obtains five disjoint translates at 3|n and exact F/genus/Hilbert formulas, and applies the published three-generator symmetry criterion to exclude the other indices. value.rationale: A natural infinite family of Pell numerical semigroups receives an exact symmetry/complete-intersection classification, with two isolated degeneracies and closed Hilbert/Frobenius/genus formulas for every symmetric index. Symmetry and Hilbert series are central numerical-semigroup invariants and the proof exposes a structural five-residue decomposition. The work is not arbitrary finite enumeration or substitution into a table.
